applicabilityBasis.summary: fxSAVE is an ERC-4626 vault share over the tokenized f(x) Stability Pool. It compounds wstETH and WBTC rewards into additional fxUSD and USDC. Redemption burns shares for fxSP and then extracts pool assets, or routes a conversion to digital assets; it does not represent a fixed-dollar payment obligation.

genius.notes: Assess the strategy-vault share independently of fxUSD and USDC. Documentation identifies Concentrator as builder and Aladdin DAO as the associated protocol organization, without establishing a separate legal token issuer. No GENIUS payment-stablecoin authorization or definitive financial-instrument classification is asserted. Interface terms effective March 5, 2026 identify community contributors rather than a legal entity and exclude U.S. residents, citizens and agents. Those interface restrictions do not establish a GENIUS foreign exception or an EU exclusion, and they do not prove that governance participants cannot constitute an issuer.
